raw_response: {"diagnosis":"raw_transactions holds 27 txn_ids delivered twice in the same batch, as record_version 1 and 2 with different amounts. silver_transactions has no dedup, so 25 of them (the POSTED ones) show up as duplicates and inflate the gold counts and totals. The fix keeps only the highest record_version per txn_id, on the assumption that the higher version is the correction.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
